arxiv-2110-05530.title: A new analysis of galaxy 2-point functions in the BOSS survey, including full-shape information and post-reconstruction BAO
arxiv-2110-05530.creator: Martin White
arxiv-2110-05530.description: Abstract We present a new method for consistent, joint analysis of the pre- and post-reconstruction galaxy two-point functions of the BOSS survey. The post-reconstruction correlation function is used to accurately measure the distance-redshift relation and expansion history, while the pre-reconstruction power spectrum multipoles constrain the broad-band shape and the rate-of-growth of large-scale structure.

arxiv-2202-13306.title: Heroes in oriented complete multipartite graphs
arxiv-2202-13306.creator: Pierre Aboulker, Guillaume Aubian, Pierre Charbit
arxiv-2202-13306.description: Abstract The dichromatic number of a digraph is the minimum size of a partition of its vertices into acyclic induced subgraphs. Given a class of digraphs 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , a digraph H H is a hero in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} if H H -free digraphs of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} have bounded dichromatic number. In a seminal paper, Berger at al.

arxiv-2203-05793.title: PathSAGE: Spatial Graph Attention Neural Networks With Random Path Sampling
arxiv-2203-05793.creator: Junhua Ma, Jiajun Li, Xueming Li✉, Xu Li
arxiv-2203-05793.description: Abstract Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) achieve great success in non-Euclidean structure data processing recently. In existing studies, deeper layers are used in CCNs to extract deeper features of Euclidean structure data. However, for non-Euclidean structure data, too deep GCNs will confront with problems like ”neighbor explosion” and ”over-smoothing”, it also cannot be applied to large datasets.

arxiv-2210-16270.title: Space-Time Graph Neural Networks with Stochastic Graph Perturbations
arxiv-2210-16270.creator: Samar Hadou, Charilaos I. Kanatsoulis, Alejandro Ribeiro
arxiv-2210-16270.description: Abstract Space-time graph neural networks (ST-GNNs) are recently developed architectures that learn efficient graph representations of time-varying data. ST-GNNs are particularly useful in multi-agent systems, due to their stability properties and their ability to respect communication delays between the agents. In this paper we revisit the stability properties of ST-GNNs and prove that they are stable to stochastic graph perturbations.

arxiv-2301-07666.title: DDS: Decoupled Dynamic Scene-Graph Generation Network
arxiv-2301-07666.creator: A S M Iftekhar, Raphael Ruschel, Satish Kumar, Suya You, B. S. Manjunath
arxiv-2301-07666.description: Abstract Scene-graph generation involves creating a structural representation of the relationships between objects in a scene by predicting subject-object-relation triplets from input data. Existing methods show poor performance in detecting triplets outside of a predefined set, primarily due to their reliance on dependent feature learning.

arxiv-2306-02073.title: Verifying C ++ Dynamic Binding
arxiv-2306-02073.creator: Niels Mommen, Bart Jacobs
arxiv-2306-02073.description: Abstract . We propose an approach for modular verification of programs written in an object-oriented language where, like in C ++ , the same virtual method call is bound to different methods at different points during the construction or destruction of an object.

arxiv-2501-18321.title: Ultra-large mutually synchronized networks of 10 nm spin Hall nano-oscillators
arxiv-2501-18321.creator: Nilamani Behera, Avinash Kumar Chaurasiya, Akash Kumar, Roman Khymyn, Artem Litvinenko, Lakhan Bainsla, Ahmad A. Awad, Johan Åkerman
arxiv-2501-18321.description: Abstract While mutually interacting spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) hold great promise for wireless communication, neural networks, neuromorphic computing, and Ising machines, the highest number of synchronized SHNOs remains limited to N N = 64. Using ultra-narrow 10 and 20-nm nano-constrictions in W-Ta/CoFeB/MgO trilayers, we demonstrate mutually synchronized SHNO networks of up to N N = 105,000.

arxiv-2506-23104.title: DC-TTA: Divide-and-Conquer Framework for Test-Time Adaptation of Interactive Segmentation
arxiv-2506-23104.creator: Jihun Kim*, Hoyong Kwon*, Hyeokjun Kweon*, Wooseong Jeong, Kuk-Jin Yoon
arxiv-2506-23104.description: Abstract Interactive segmentation (IS) allows users to iteratively refine object boundaries with minimal cues, such as positive and negative clicks. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) has garnered attention in the IS community for its promptable segmentation capabilities, it often struggles in specialized domains or when handling complex scenarios (e.g., camouflaged or multi-part objects).

pmc-11619677.title: The effectiveness of oral irrigators on periodontal health status and oral hygiene of orthodontic patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11619677.creator: Zahra Zarei, Maryam Yazdi, Leila Sadeghalbanaei, Shabnam Tahamtan
pmc-11619677.description: BackgroundAn Oral irrigator, known as a dental waterjet (DWJ), is an adjunctive oral hygiene tool to remove dental plaque. The aim of this study was to systematically evaluate the effectiveness of oral irrigators on orthodontic patients’ oral hygiene and periodontal status.

pmc-12411845.title: Ectopic mandibular third molar associated with cystic lesion and extraoral approach: case report
pmc-12411845.creator: Levi Saulo Rodrigues de Jesus, Bruno Dezen Vieira, Alexander Tadeu Sverzut
pmc-12411845.description: Impacted mandibular third molars are classified by its relation with the second molars and with the ascending ramus of the mandible. Ectopic third molars do not obey this classification, being possibly found in the condylar region, in the ascending ramus of the mandible, in the coronoid process or in the base of the mandible.

pmc-12468830.title: Confirmation of Large Language Models in Head and Neck Cancer Staging
pmc-12468830.creator: Mehmet Kayaalp, Hatice Bölek, Hatime Arzu Yaşar
pmc-12468830.description: Background/Objectives: Head and neck cancer (HNC) is a heterogeneous group of malignancies in which staging plays a critical role in guiding treatment and prognosis. Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Grok have emerged as potential tools in oncology, yet their clinical applicability in staging remains unclear.

pmc-12739091.title: Coexistence of familial dysalbuminemic hyperthyroixinemia and papillary thyroid carcinoma: a rare case report and diagnostic challenge
pmc-12739091.creator: Yajie Li, Minghui Ren, Mengshu Lu, Hongqi Fan, Dai Cui
pmc-12739091.description: Familial dysalbuminemic hyperthyroxinemia (FDH) is a form of euthyroid hyperthyroxinemia caused by ALB gene variants that is commonly misdiagnosed in clinical practice. When coexisting with papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC), this condition may complicate postoperative management strategies. This study aims to enhance clinical recognition of the coexistence of FDH and PTC and explore evidence-based management approaches.

pmc-13075529.title: Cost‐Effectiveness Analysis of Ritlecitinib Compared With No Treatment in Patients With Severe Alopecia Areata in Japan
pmc-13075529.creator: Akira Yuasa, Kazumasa Kamei, Shota Saito, Masashi Mikami, Tatsunori Murata, Samantha Kiyomi Kurosky, Ernest H. Law, Kouki Nakamura, Rie Ueki
pmc-13075529.description: The efficacy and safety of ritlecitinib, a dual inhibitor of Janus kinase 3 (JAK3) and tyrosine kinase expressed in hepatocellular carcinoma (TEC) family kinases, have been demonstrated in the ALLEGRO phase 2b/3 trial that enrolled patients aged ≥ 12 years with alopecia areata (AA) and ≥ 50% scalp hair loss.

pmc-13259020.title: Energy-Adaptive Multi-Dimensional Learning Control for Federated Learning in Energy-Harvesting AIoT Systems
pmc-13259020.creator: Dong Kun Noh, Changmin Kwak
pmc-13259020.description: This paper addresses the problem of efficient federated learning in energy-harvesting AIoT systems, where time-varying energy availability may lead to device blackouts and unstable learning performance. To address this issue, we propose an energy-adaptive multi-dimensional learning control framework that jointly determines model complexity and training intensity based on the real-time energy state of each device.
